protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In the original implementation, parseAuthRequest copied redirect_uri from the authorize request without looking up the client or checking clientInfo.redirectUris; completeAuthorization then constructed the redirect Location from options.request.redirectUri and attached the authorization code. The token endpoint's later redirectUris.includes check did not prevent an auto-approved authorization flow from sending a live code to an attacker-controlled callback.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 3b2ae809e9256d292079bb15ea9fe49439a0779c. This root commit first wrote oauth-provider.ts, including the unvalidated authorize parser, the redirect sink, and the distinct token-side validation. It is the smallest surviving public commit object that first wrote the vulnerable mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. git rev-list --parents -n 1 shows only 3b2ae809e9256d292079bb15ea9fe49439a0779c, its parent list is empty, and its tree contains only oauth-provider.ts; no parent tree can contain an earlier version of the vulnerable lines.
